mockups.summary: Cake Box: cocoa hero with an oversized centred serif, an offset 3-photo strip, small-caps labels, twine-and-tag dividers, alternating dark/cream sections. Copy exact, 'C' below the footer.
notes: The headline's descenders ('y' in story) touch the subhead line, and the 'g' descender overlaps 'MAPLE HOLLOW' under the logo; fix spacing in the build.
Added design labels ('Maple Hollow · Baked by hand', 'Our promise', etc.) are restatements of intake facts, not new claims.
